faq: Do I need a logo already?
No. If you have one, we use it. If not, we create a simple wordmark or icon from your shop name and style notes. For a full logo design, ask for a quote, because that takes more rounds.
Can you write my About section if I have little to say?
Yes. Answer five short questions about how you started and how you make things, and we write it in your voice. You approve it before it goes live, and you can ask for changes in your revisions.
Will the banner fit on phones?
Yes. Etsy crops banners differently on desktop and mobile, so we keep the main message in the safe area and test both views before we hand over the files.
Do you change my shop name?
No, unless you ask. A shop name change on Etsy has limits, so we confirm what is possible first. Branding work uses your current name, and we flag if the name causes any confusion.

desc:
Etsy shop branding gives your shop a matching banner, icon, About section and policies so buyers see one clear brand. Ecom Swift LLC designs the visuals to Etsy's sizes and writes the shop text in your own voice.

## What is Etsy shop branding?

Etsy shop branding is the set of visual and written elements that tell visitors who you are before they read a single listing. It includes the shop banner, the shop icon, the colors and fonts you use, the About section, the shop announcement and the policies.

Ecom Swift LLC builds these as one set, so the shop looks like a single business instead of a collection of unrelated items.

## Why a shop needs a recognizable look

Etsy puts thousands of similar items next to each other. When shoppers click through to a shop, they judge in seconds whether it feels real and careful. A missing banner, a stretched icon or an About section with one line gives the impression of a shop that is not looking after its details.

A consistent look also helps people remember you. Someone who saw your items in a search and later sees your icon on social media should connect them without effort.

## How branding supports sales and loyalty

Branding does not replace good products, but it supports them. A clear banner tells visitors what you make. An About section explains who makes it and why, which matters to Etsy buyers who like to buy from a person. Policies written in plain language reduce worry about returns and delivery.

Repeat buyers are shaped by branding too. A shop with a steady style is easier to follow, easier to recommend and easier to extend into new products. Packaging inserts and matching section graphics carry the same look to the customer's doorstep. We make the shop look more professional and trustworthy, though sales still depend on your products and market.

## What a complete shop brand includes

- A banner designed to Etsy's size, tested on desktop and mobile.
- A shop icon that stays clear when shown very small.
- A color palette and font choices you can reuse.
- An About section that tells your story and your process.
- A shop announcement for visitors, written in your voice.
- Shop policies tidied and made easy to read.
- Section graphics that match the banner, in larger packages.
- A packaging insert design and a one-page brand guide.
- Social profile images cut to the sizes platforms use.

## What we do

You tell us about your style, your favorite colors and the story behind the shop. We prepare concepts and share them for your feedback, then refine the one you choose. Files are exported at the right dimensions so nothing is cropped badly on a phone.

Next we write the text. The About section is drafted from your answers, even if you think you have little to say, and the announcement and policies follow the same tone. The Basic package covers banner and icon. Standard adds written text, tidied policies and two banner concepts. Premium adds section graphics, a packaging insert, a brand guide and social images. You keep every file.

## Do and avoid

**Do:**
- Choose two or three colors and use them everywhere.
- Show your real work or process in the About section.
- Keep the banner simple enough to read on a phone.
- Write policies in short, clear sentences.
- Use the same icon on every platform.

**Avoid:**
- Putting too much text on the banner.
- Using fonts that are hard to read at small sizes.
- Copying another shop's style or wording.
- Photos or artwork you have no permission to publish.
- Changing your look every few months.

## Who this service is for

It suits a new seller opening a shop who wants it to look finished from day one. It also suits an older shop with a mismatched banner and icon, and a maker who is expanding into packaging and social media and needs one consistent look.

## What we need from you

Tell us what you sell, who buys it and which shops you admire. Share any logo, colors or images you already have. We work through your Etsy shop as a manager with limited permissions where available, or send you the files to upload, and we never need your password.
